direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene occupies at least 70% of main; side content fits its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald green and brushed silver at native aspect in header and opening story only
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions tied to real state; 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness for provider identity fully separate from investigation evidence under distinct headings, status and controls; action bar with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposals remain untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved plan may coexist while replacements await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG filling at least 70% of main from real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

Separate provider-identity readiness from the Verified findings evidence task with distinct headings, status lines and controls in the side zone.
Raise verified-facts body copy to a full 16px/24 and give the 3/0/3 metric tiles equal height with tabular numerals.
Link each finding row bidirectionally to its SVG track or station so hover and keyboard focus glow both zones identically.
On selecting any path, swap the primary to one-click Approve and then present the Authorize this decision wall, with the selected path summary carried into both.
Add a feasible-route trace in emerald across stations for the focused path option, static after 240ms and removed under reduced motion.
Align the three side-zone price and finish metrics on one baseline grid so 83h, 35h and 17.5h compare at a glance.
Visually split the retained approved plan from the three dashed PROPOSED untracked tasks with a labelled divider, since blocked prior work and replacements can coexist here.
Add depth and state glow to task card 01 only while focused, keeping cards 02 and 03 flat silver-dashed to reinforce awaiting approval.
Enlarge the 1/2/3 proposal stepper targets to 36px with visible focus ring and arrow-key movement.
Keep the strong silver cross-hatch preview, and add one cinematic 240ms capacity drain 24h to 0h on the CELL-MILL-2 tile when the preview arms.
Make the WILL GO OFFLINE banner and the machine tile a single linked focusable preview control with aria-pressed state.
Reduce duplicated WILL GO OFFLINE copy inside the tile to one x marker plus OFFLINE-pending label so the preview reads instantly.
Separate provider-identity readiness checks from the Investigate source evidence task in the side zone; the current META MODEL INVESTIGATION panel conflates their framing.
The empty Verified findings zone leaves a large void; fill it with a compact cleared-by-capacity-change summary and the two remaining feasible paths at 16px.
Add a brief emerald re-route trace that visibly bypasses the hatched CELL-MILL-2, never crossing it, on state load.

Give the constrained Split option the same silver cross-hatch, x marker and plain constrained text treatment in both scene and side zone for instant parity.
Highlight the feasible substitute route through CELL-MILL-1 in the scene when its side-zone row receives focus.

Match step 4 task-card treatment exactly for the replan, with the same dashed untracked styling and due-time layout for continuity.
Add state glow to CELL-MILL-1 as the accepted-plan station and keep cross-hatched CELL-MILL-2 route-free in the flow layer.
Increase contrast on LOCKED cards 02 and 03: silver titles at full #C5CCD4 with dimmer dashed rules so the sequence reads without colour alone.
Animate the dashed chain line once from 01 to 03 on entry, then hold static; remove it under reduced motion.
Compress the right-zone passphrase guidance to two lines at 16px so all three retained-evidence stages fit without crowding at 768px height.
Most departments read uniformly OFFLINE-hatched; differentiate held and blocked machines with the legend's held marker so the cascade impact varies by department.
Strengthen the mills to lathes recovery arc with layered depth, a moving flow dash on trigger, and endpoint glow on the feasible machines only.
Raise department micro-labels and machine counts to at least 12px and give each department header a 36px focusable target for keyboard exploration.
The required order is honoured and judge impact is high; enlarge the cascade visual caption to 16px so the 35-operation consequence is legible without zooming.
Add one concise outcome metric strip after What you will see, reusing 120 versus 80 and 70 parts at risk, to sharpen clarity inside the fixed order.
Increase contrast of the hero image's lower three-column bar text to full silver so SEE EVERY DEPENDENCY, SIMULATE RECOVERY and KEEP PEOPLE IN CONTROL read at thumbnail scale.
